name: Bjorn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjorn Halvorsen's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing. Growing up in the Norwegian countryside, he spent countless hours tinkering with engines, initially modifying snowmobiles before moving onto cars. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics. Prior to joining Stewart-Haas Racing, Bjorn honed his skills at a smaller European racing outfit, where he quickly rose through the ranks to become a key member of their technical team. 

Bjorn's approach as a Technical Director centers around fostering a culture of continuous improvement and encouraging innovative thinking within his team. He believes in empowering his engineers to take ownership of their projects and values data-driven decision-making. His focus on aerodynamic efficiency and his knack for identifying unconventional solutions make him a valuable asset. While generally calm and collected, he possesses an unwavering determination to push the boundaries of performance.

physical.description: Bjorn is of average height with a lean build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool in his pocket.
Insists on drinking black coffee, brewed with a specific type of Norwegian water.
Has a habit of sketching aerodynamic concepts on napkins during meetings.
